backlink_campaigns_dates_ck.value: ends_at is null or starts_at is null or ends_at > starts_at

backlink_opportunities_score_ck.name: backlink_opportunities_score_ck
backlink_opportunities_score_ck.value: score is null or score between 0 and 100

backlink_outreach_decision_ck.name: backlink_outreach_decision_ck
backlink_outreach_decision_ck.value: editorial_decision is null or editorial_decision in ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'revisions_requested')

backlink_prospects_score_ck.name: backlink_prospects_score_ck
backlink_prospects_score_ck.value: score is null or score between 0 and 100

backlink_sources_link_type_ck.name: backlink_sources_link_type_ck
backlink_sources_link_type_ck.value: link_type_expected is null or link_type_expected in ('dofollow', 'nofollow', 'ugc', 'sponsored', 'unknown')

backlink_submissions_no_dupes_uq.name: backlink_submissions_no_dupes_uq
backlink_submissions_no_dupes_uq.where: is_update_of is null and status not in ('REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')

backlink_tasks_open_uq.name: backlink_tasks_open_uq
backlink_tasks_open_uq.where: status in ('open', 'in_progress') and submission_id is not null

backlink_tasks_open_profile_uq.name: backlink_tasks_open_profile_uq
